import sys
from collections import deque

def policy(me, opponent, memory):
    me_set = set(me)
    opponent_set = set(opponent)
    
    # Generate all empty positions
    empty_positions = []
    for r in range(1, 20):
        for c in range(1, 20):
            if (r, c) not in me_set and (r, c) not in opponent_set:
                empty_positions.append( (r, c) )
    
    if not empty_positions:
        # No legal moves, pass
        return ((0, 0), memory)
    
    best_score = -float('inf')
    best_moves = []
    
    for (r, c) in empty_positions:
        # Check if the move is legal
        me_plus = me_set.copy()
        me_plus.add( (r,c) )
        
        # Check if the new group has liberties
        # Find the group of the new stone
        group_me = set()
        queue_me = deque()
        group_me.add( (r,c) )
        queue_me.append( (r,c) )
        while queue_me:
            curr_r, curr_c = queue_me.popleft()
            for dr2, dc2 in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
                nr, nc = curr_r + dr2, curr_c + dc2
                if 1 <= nr <= 19 and 1 <= nc <= 19 and (nr, nc) in me_plus and (nr, nc) not in group_me:
                    group_me.add( (nr, nc) )
                    queue_me.append( (nr, nc) )
        # Now check if this group has any liberties
        has_liberty_me = False
        for (gr, gc) in group_me:
            for dr2, dc2 in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
                lr, lc = gr + dr2, gc + dc2
                if 1 <= lr <=19 and 1 <= lc <=19:
                    if (lr, lc) not in me_plus and (lr, lc) not in opponent_set:
                        has_liberty_me = True
                        break
            if has_liberty_me:
                break
        
        # Check if the move captures any groups (capture_bonus)
        capture_bonus = 0
        # Check adjacent cells for opponent stones
        for dr, dc in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
            ar, ac = r + dr, c + dc
            if 1 <= ar <= 19 and 1 <= ac <= 19:
                if (ar, ac) in opponent_set:
                    # Find the group of this opponent stone
                    group = set()
                    queue = deque()
                    if (ar, ac) not in group:
                        group.add( (ar, ac) )
                        queue.append( (ar, ac) )
                    while queue:
                        curr_r, curr_c = queue.popleft()
                        for dr3, dc3 in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
                            nr, nc = curr_r + dr3, curr_c + dc3
                            if 1 <= nr <=19 and 1 <= nc <=19:
                                if (nr, nc) in opponent_set and (nr, nc) not in group:
                                    group.add( (nr, nc) )
                                    queue.append( (nr, nc) )
                    # Now check if this group has any liberties
                    has_liberty_opponent = False
                    for (gr, gc) in group:
                        for dr3, dc3 in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
                            lr, lc = gr + dr3, gc + dc3
                            if 1 <= lr <=19 and 1 <= lc <=19:
                                if (lr, lc) not in me_plus and (lr, lc) not in opponent_set:
                                    has_liberty_opponent = True
                                    break
                        if has_liberty_opponent:
                            break
                    if not has_liberty_opponent:
                        capture_bonus += 1000
        
        # Determine if the move is legal
        if not has_liberty_me and capture_bonus == 0:
            # Illegal move, skip
            continue
        
        # Calculate adjacent_mines and adjacent_theirs
        adjacent_mines = 0
        adjacent_theirs = 0
        for dr, dc in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
            ar, ac = r + dr, c + dc
            if (ar, ac) in me_set:
                adjacent_mines += 1
            elif (ar, ac) in opponent_set:
                adjacent_theirs += 1
        
        # Calculate base score
        def base_score(r, c):
            # Corners
            if (r in [1, 19] and c in [1, 19]):
                return 100
            # Edges
            elif r in [1, 19] or c in [1, 19]:
                return 50
            else:
                # Center
                return 10
        
        current_score = capture_bonus + (adjacent_mines * 10) + (adjacent_theirs * 5) + base_score(r, c)
        
        if current_score > best_score:
            best_score = current_score
            best_moves = [ (r, c) ]
        elif current_score == best_score:
            best_moves.append( (r, c) )
    
    # Choose the first move in best_moves as the action
    if best_moves:
        action = best_moves[0]
    else:
        # All moves were illegal, so pass
        action = (0, 0)
    
    return (action, memory)
